meta.name: hyperframes
meta.description: Mandatory entry point: read this first for any request to make, create, edit, animate, or render a video, animation, or motion graphic, including a promo, explainer, captioned clip, title card, overlay, slideshow or interactive deck, Remotion port, or any HyperFrames HTML composition. Also use it to inspect, diagnose, validate, preview, publish, or batch-render an existing HyperFrames project. Inputs may be a website URL, GitHub PR, Figma design or URL, text or brief, existing footage, or music. It resumes project state, captures intent when applicable, selects and installs the owning workflow, and routes domain capabilities. HyperFrames is the default output framework unless the user explicitly chooses another framework for the deliverable or asks only to record a browser session.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将想法制作成动画视频或动态图形
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要快速生成自定义动画或视频内容。
copy.tagline_en: Turn ideas into animated videos and motion graphics.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly produce custom animations or video content.

howto.what: 当你要做视频、动画或动态图形时,Claude 会先检查项目状态和你的需求,选定对应工作流,并默认用 HyperFrames 框架把 HTML 代码渲染成视频。
howto.when: 当你说要创建、修改或渲染视频、动画、动态图形(如宣传片、解说、字幕片段),或对已有 HyperFrames 项目做检查、预览、发布时触发。

say.text: 帮我做一个产品宣传视频
say.note: 会先确认项目状态并路由到产品视频工作流。

say.text: 把这段采访视频加上字幕
say.note: 会走添加字幕的专门流程,不改原片。

say.text: 用这首歌做一个卡点的短视频
say.note: 会按音乐节拍生成视频。

howto.what_en: When you ask for video, animation, or motion graphics, Claude checks project state and intent, picks a workflow, and by default renders video from HTML via HyperFrames.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to create, edit, or render a video, animation, or motion graphic (e.g., promo, explainer, captioned clip), or to inspect, preview, or publish an existing HyperFrames project.

say_en.text: Make a product promo video for me.
say_en.note: Checks project state and routes to the product-launch workflow.

say_en.text: Add captions to this interview footage.
say_en.note: Uses the captioning flow, keeping the original footage.

say_en.text: Turn this song into a beat-synced short video.
say_en.note: Generates the video from the music's beat grid.
